title: Allen Dulles witnessing a saucer

tellings.quote: absolutely this stuff I've heard the same stuff about uh Dulles and the you know witnessing the saucer and checks the lock and so on and so forth.

plain: A researcher named Jason Jorjani, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, says he has heard stories that Allen Dulles, a powerful American spy chief of the mid-1900s, personally saw a flying saucer. He mentions a detail about checking a lock but gives no clear account of where or when. If true, it would mean one of the most senior intelligence figures in the country had seen such a craft himself.
